'''Defensive Shields''' is the Players Committee Original-era printable Defensive Shield slip sheet archived from swccgpc.com Resources. Cutouts sleeve with the matching Decipher Defensive Shield. Overview era: [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]. History: [[History of the Players Committee]]. Icon shorthand on this sheet: [[Virtual card icons]]. Later Block packaging of the broader shield pool: [[Virtual Shields]].

'''PDF cover title (quoted):''' the Resources sheet is titled '''Virtual Set: Defensive Shields''' and states Official text as of December 4, 2006 (footer: SWCCG Player's Committee 2006). Wiki hub title is '''Defensive Shields''' (PDF never says Premium). star-wars.pl soft-label Premium Set 1 is historical only; redirects: [[Premium Set 1: Defensive Shields]], [[Virtual Shields (Original)]], [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields]].

== Launch vs later update ==

Secondary chronologies place this package between Virtual Sets 11 and 12.<ref name="plsets">[https://star-wars.pl/Tekst/1963,Star_Wars_CCG_Virtual_Sets.html Star Wars CCG Virtual Sets], star-wars.pl</ref> Primary PDF brackets sit after VS11 official text '''4 December 2006''' and before VS12 official text '''9 January 2007'''.

The Downloads catalog snapshot (Internet Archive, 24 October 2007) listed lid=33 with catalog line '''Official text as of August 23, 2006'''. The Resources PDF used on this hub is the '''4 December 2006''' refresh (same calendar day as the VirtualCards1.pdf Legacy sheet). Keep those labels separate; do not erase the earlier catalog date.

Forum discussion also sought an even older black-on-white Defensive Shields printing (PM-only circulation noted there).<ref name="forum22434">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=22434 forum.starwarsccg.org t=22434]</ref> That earlier printing is not the Dec 2006 Resources PDF and is not reproduced here.

== ICON KEY ==

This PDF prints the same ICON KEY wording family as the Dec 2006 Legacy VS1 sheet (Immune to Alter / Control / Sense; pilot-power X; maintenance; grabber; triangle shorthands). See [[Virtual card icons]] for the quoted legend. Crop from this PDF:
